name: 48001 · Algonac, MI
findings: ZIP 48001 (Algonac) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48001 (Algonac) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48001 (Algonac) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
